values.note: Family electric site $35, non-electric $25; the site fee covers up to two camping units. Every vehicle entering the park also needs a county Park Annual Membership or Daily Permit (read by plate scanner at the entrance). Cancelling 14+ days out is a full refund, under 14 days none.

fees.source: https://www.waukeshacounty.gov/parks-and-land-use/parks-and-recreation/parks-and-trails/camping/ ('2026 Family Camping Fees / Site fee includes up to two camping units / Parks Annual Membership or Parks Daily Permit required for each vehicle that enters the Park. / Family Campsite : $25/night / Family Electric Campsite: $35/night'; cancellation policy), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Nine family sites have electric (bring a 50-ft cord to reach the pedestal). Three separate group sites.

sites.source: https://www.waukeshacounty.gov/parks-and-land-use/parks-and-recreation/parks-and-trails/camping/ ('Family Campsites : 17 Total'; 'Electricity at nine family campsites and three reserved group camping areas'; 'Tip: Bring a 50-ft. cord to reach the pedestal at electric sites'; 'Vehicle/Camper Maximum Lengths: ... values.note: Waukesha County's WebTrac reservation system. No unit may stay more than 7 consecutive nights in any county campground, then must be off the property 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.waukeshacounty.gov/parks-and-land-use/parks-and-recreation/parks-and-trails/camping/ ('To see available dates, campground maps, and book your site, please click here' -> wauk.co/camp -> WebTrac; 'Limit: No camper/camping Unit can stay greater than 7 consecutive nights in any Waukesha County Campground. The camper/camping unit shall be removed from the property for at least 24 hours before being eligible to return.'), read 2026-11-16

note: Waukesha County's first regional park, west of Muskego: a 60-acre old-growth hardwood State Natural Area with hiking loops, a small swimming pond with beach house and fishing pier, archery range and bridle trail. --Claude
